title: Three Things That Made the Modern Economy

sentences.en: Tim Harford is a master at picking out the perfect little story that explains some huge economic principle.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·哈福德非常擅长挑选出那些能解释宏大经济学原理的完美小故事。

sentences.en: In his long-running Financial Times column called The Undercover Economist,

sentences.zh: 他一直是我了解广阔世界背后经济学与数学知识的首选向导。

sentences.en: His latest radio series for the BBC is called 50 Things That Made the Modern Economy.

sentences.en: And with this project, Tim has made a podcast almost perfectly crafted to light up the pleasure centers of my nerd brain.
